fault_summary: each worker, on its own CPU, holds one global lock for its whole 5 ms of work, so the four workers run one after another instead of in parallel

threads.name: watchdog
threads.role: ends the run if the program does not end itself

threads.name: flusher
threads.role: writes back the previous batch under cache_lock every round
